# Builds ./app from every .c file under src/. Each subcommand owns a directory
# src/<name>/; new source files placed there are picked up automatically.
#
# OPTFLAGS selects the optimization level (release by default); CFLAGS,
# CPPFLAGS and LDFLAGS may be supplied for extra flags without losing the
# required ones below.

CC       ?= cc
OPTFLAGS ?= -O2 -DNDEBUG
WARNINGS := -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wstrict-prototypes \
            -Wmissing-prototypes

ALL_CFLAGS   := -std=c17 $(WARNINGS) $(OPTFLAGS) $(CFLAGS)
ALL_CPPFLAGS := -Isrc -MMD -MP $(CPPFLAGS)

BUILD  := build
TARGET := app
SRCS   := $(shell find src -name '*.c' | LC_ALL=C sort)
OBJS   := $(SRCS:%.c=$(BUILD)/%.o)
DEPS   := $(OBJS:.o=.d)

.PHONY: all clean

all: $(TARGET)

$(TARGET): $(OBJS)
	$(CC) $(ALL_CFLAGS) $(LDFLAGS) -o $@ $^

$(BUILD)/%.o: %.c
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	$(CC) $(ALL_CPPFLAGS) $(ALL_CFLAGS) -c -o $@ $<

clean:
	rm -rf $(BUILD) $(TARGET)

-include $(DEPS)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds an optimized release binary at ./app from a clean tree.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

jobs=$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null || nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 4)
make clean >/dev/null
make -j"$jobs" OPTFLAGS="-O2 -DNDEBUG"

#ifndef SUITE_CALC_H
#define SUITE_CALC_H

/*
 * `app calc`: 64-bit integer expression evaluator (see SPEC.md, section "calc").
 *
 * Reads standard input, writes standard output. argv[0] is "calc".
 * Returns the process exit status.
 */
int calc_main(int argc, char **argv);

#endif /* SUITE_CALC_H */

#ifndef SUITE_LRU_H
#define SUITE_LRU_H

/*
 * `app lru`: LRU cache simulator (see SPEC.md, section "lru").
 *
 * Reads standard input, writes standard output. argv[0] is "lru".
 * Returns the process exit status.
 */
int lru_main(int argc, char **argv);

#endif /* SUITE_LRU_H */

#ifndef SUITE_WORDFREQ_H
#define SUITE_WORDFREQ_H

/*
 * `app wordfreq`: word frequencies (see SPEC.md, section "wordfreq").
 *
 * Reads standard input, writes standard output. argv[0] is "wordfreq".
 * Returns the process exit status.
 */
int wordfreq_main(int argc, char **argv);

#endif /* SUITE_WORDFREQ_H */
